text: Standing amidst this architecture, I am struck by the duality of utility and conceptual space. The corridor is clinical yet inviting, suggesting order and purpose, while the glow of projectors and printed words on the walls provoke curiosity about the narratives unfolding here. My mind feels enlivened, curious about the intersection between function and meaning—a place where safety equipment coexists with innovation and research. To be here is to feel the quiet anticipation of discovery, the sense that every environment has a story if I choose to witness it deeply.
